about.title: About ClimateGuard AI
about.subtitle: Bilingual Climate Early-Warning & Agro-Advisory Agent for Tamil Nadu Farmers
about.missionDesc: Designed for farmers across Tamil Nadu, ClimateGuard AI couples open high-resolution meteorological models with deterministic agronomical rule engines. It ensures early, actionable, and hyper-local safeguards before extreme heat, rain, drought, or wind impact crops.
about.boundaryDesc: Large Language Models generate human-friendly bilingual explanations, but NEVER compute risk or fabricate warnings. Hazard levels strictly adhere to IMD thresholds and multi-model ensemble consensus (ECMWF, GFS, ICON).
about.officialDesc: All advisories explicitly reinforce that official India Meteorological Department (IMD) bulletins, yellow/orange/red alerts, and State Disaster Management advisories supersede all automated model guidance.
about.f1: 6h / 24h / 48h proactive field checklist for timely intervention
about.f2: Bilingual Tamil and English support with native voice synthesis
about.f3: Ensemble spread confidence detection: warns when forecast models disagree
about.f4: SMS-ready daily farm brief formatted within 300 characters
about.f5: Zero-hallucination spray window evaluator preventing chemical runoff

risk.title: Computed Climate Hazard Levels
risk.ruleNote: Determined by strict Python rules (not LLM decided)

heatDescs.LOW: Temperatures are within normal crop physiological range.
heatDescs.HIGH: Severe heat stress; moisture depletion and wilting risk.
heatDescs.CRITICAL: Heatwave conditions! Immediate canopy cooling required.

rainDescs.LOW: Light rain or dry conditions (0 - 15.5 mm).
rainDescs.HIGH: IMD Classification: Heavy Rain Alert (64.5 - 115.5 mm).
rainDescs.CRITICAL: IMD Classification: Very Heavy to Extremely Heavy (>115.5 mm).

droughtDescs.HIGH: Extended dry spell; significant crop moisture deficit.
droughtDescs.CRITICAL: Severe drought stress; life-saving irrigation needed.

windDescs.MODERATE: Breezy conditions (25 - 40 km/h); exercise spray drift care.
windDescs.HIGH: Strong winds (> 40 km/h); banana and tall crop lodging risk.
windDescs.CRITICAL: Gale/Squall (> 55 km/h); severe crop damage likely.

confidence.disagreeAlert: Models disagree, check official IMD alert
